## Implemented — consolidation + AC4 decision recorded

**AC4 decision: ACCEPT the raising posture of `_config_sources.repo_root`'s final
`Path.cwd()` fallback.** Rationale (unchanged from the 3198 analysis this ticket quotes): a
silently-wrong repo root is worse than a loud failure. Detached children no longer reach the
fallback — `rebar._proc.spawn_detached` anchors every detached rebar child to a durable cwd —
and long-lived IN-PROCESS work (daemon threads, a reconciler run "as a daemon from anywhere")
must either pass `explicit`, set `REBAR_ROOT`, or accept the loud failure. The decision is now
recorded in `repo_root`'s docstring (the location AC4 names), citing this ticket. No behavior
change.

**The consolidation, per the certified plan:**
* `rebar._proc.spawn_detached(module, func, arg, *, env, stderr)` — the ONE implementation:
  PYTHONPATH bootstrap, `-c` re-entry stub, platform detach flags (`_detach_kwargs` moved
  here), stdio discipline, durable cwd via `detached_child_cwd(arg)`. It RE-RAISES; env stays
  caller-supplied (helper layers PYTHONPATH onto a copy). `_proc` stays a stdlib-only leaf.
* The three sites collapsed onto it: `push.py` keeps its secret-stripped
  `project_child_env(relationship="unrelated")` + `REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always` env and its
  `except OSError` + `%r` log; drain/sweep keep their store-scoped log sinks, canonical
  tracker arguments, and broad `except Exception` logs. Per-site `_detach_kwargs` deleted.
* Tests: new `tests/unit/test_spawn_detached.py` — a STATIC source scan pinning that the
  spawn signature (`DETACHED_PROCESS`/`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, the `sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv…)`
  re-entry) appears only in `_proc.py`; a stdlib-only-leaf pin; construction/env-copy/re-raise
  unit tests; `test_windows_detach_kwargs` migrated from test_enrich_drain.py as planned. The
  two argv-pinning tests (drain 2006 / sweep vicuna) now patch `_proc`'s own `subprocess`,
  since that is where the one Popen lives. The end-to-end cwd contract tests
  (test_detached_child_cwd.py) pass unchanged — they patch the global `subprocess.Popen`,
  which still intercepts the helper.

Behavior-preserving throughout: no exception-surface change, no env change, no argv change
(the `-c` stub now spells `import m; m.f(sys.argv[1])` instead of `from p import m; …` —
same import, same call). `make lint` (incl. complexity ratchet), `make typecheck`, and the
affected test files (spawn_detached, detached_child_cwd, compact_trigger, enrich_drain,
enrich_queue, push_strict/parent_exit/child_env: 232 tests) all green. Proceeding to Gerrit.
